title: The Explosion That Left No Crater (Tunguska 1908)
rationale: Owner named NO CRATER? as the primary cover. It states the episode's central question, matches the title promise (no crater) and is answered by verified evidence; the same painted composition is the film's first frame, so the click promise is on screen at 0.0 s. concepts.title: The Explosion That Left No Crater (Tunguska 1908)
concepts.visual_promise: An airburst fireball over the Siberian taiga at dawn, forest falling below
concepts.main_subject: Tunguska explosion fireball over the forest, no crater
concepts.hook_15s: Frame 0 = cover; scene rewinds to a calm dawn forest, then the bolide streaks in, bursts above the trees and the shock wave flattens the forest
facts: June 30, 1908 airburst over central Siberia (NASA EO)
about 2,000 km2 of forest damaged (NASA History: 830 sq mi)
no large impact crater found; Kulik reached the site in 1927 (NASA History)
burst likely 6-10 km above the surface (NASA EO)
